description: A single merchant's targeted-keyword performance across ALL its PLA performance campaigns (os_ads_search, smart_shopping) for one period: currency-converted spend, impressions, clicks, and attributed sales per matched keyword x keyword match type x campaign. Scoped to one advertiser via the mandatory os_client_id filter. CTR/CPC/CPM/ROI are derived downstream from these raw aggregates.

keyword_match_type.description: Match type of the targeted keyword (EXACT / PHRASE / BROAD / ...).

campaign_id.description: Marketing campaign_id the keyword served under.

campaign_name.description: Human-readable campaign name (alias) for the marketing campaign.

campaign_group_id.description: Marketing campaign group_id the campaign belongs to.

os_client_id.description: Advertiser (merchant) client_id. Mandatory filter: the single advertiser client_id to scope the report to.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.cost * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Keyword ad spend over the period, converted to the marketplace currency.

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)
impressions.description: Ad impressions served for this keyword.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)

attributed_sales.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN k.program_per_click_timestamp_sales * scc.conversion_factor ELSE 0 END), 0)
attributed_sales.description: Per-click-timestamp attributed sales for this keyword, converted to the marketplace currency. ROI is derived downstream as attributed_sales / spend.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_keyword_performance_report` AS k INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON ctd.account_id = k.account_id AND ctd.campaign_id = k.campaign_id AND ctd.client_id = k.client_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions` AS mcd ON ctd.client_id = mcd.client_id AND ctd.marketing_campaign_id = mcd.marketing_campaign_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_group_dimensions` AS mcgd ON ctd.client_id = mcgd.client_id AND ctd.marketing_campaign_group_id = mcgd.marketing_campaign_group_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.marketplace_client_id = k.marketplace_client_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = k.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND k.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND (mcd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' OR mcd.campaign_origin IS NULL) AND LOWER(mcgd.campaign_type) IN ('performance') AND LOWER(mcgd.campaign_subtype) IN ('os_ads_search', 'smart_shopping') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
